# A28: ten SWiM core studies the AI could not confirm on the narrow scope and outcome check (2026-10-14)

*Generated by `code/provenance/audit_and_repair/apply_a26_swim_core_checks_2026-10-14.py`. These are the ten of the 30 unconfirmed SWiM core studies whose extraction rows show a red flag against the narrow reading of criterion 2 (a legal or administrative access rule or mechanism) or against criterion 4 (a household access outcome). The AI's pointers are not decisions. Fill `researcher_decision` (include = keep, exclude + code = reverse) in a copy of the CSV and apply it with `code/screening/apply_a16_adjudications.py`; a reversal needs its effect row archived first (`apply_a26_effect_row_rulings_2026-10-14.py` is the pattern) and changes the family counts.*
